features: ALL-ROUND HEALTH MONITORING: Monitor all your important vitals including ECG, Heart Rate, Blood Oxygen (SpO2), Blood Pressure, and Heart Rate Variability for a clearer view of your daily health. The band also continuously tracks Skin Temperature enabling easy tracking of your recovery progress during flu seasons.

ADVANCED BODY COMPOSITION ANALYSIS: Powered by cutting-edge BIA technology, SENSE helps you track fat and muscle trends over time, giving you deeper insight into how your body responds to training, nutrition, and recovery — making it an ideal companion for your fitness, fat-loss, or muscle-building journey.

MULTI-FACETED WELLNESS TRACKING: Track sleep patterns, stress levels, and female health cycles, receive timely medication reminders, and gain intelligent insights that help you understand daily routines and build healthier, more consistent wellness habits over time.

SCIENCE-BACKED INTELLIGENCE: Advanced sensors work in harmony with intelligent algorithms to continuously analyze your body’s signals in real time. SENSE transforms complex biometric data into meaningful health insights you can understand, track, and act on — every day.

MEDICAL-GRADE ECG: Equipped with a high-precision 500Hz medical-grade GH3228T ECG chip, the band enables high-fidelity signal acquisition and stable waveform capture, helping ensure accurate heart rhythm monitoring. The heart screening function detects potential signs of atrial fibrillation, helping you stay updated on your cardiac health with clarity.

DUAL STRAPS & IP68 RATED: SENSE includes a breathable nylon loop for all-day comfort and workouts, along with a magnetic loop for a refined, premium look. Its IP68 rating ensures that it is fully dustproof and deep waterproof upto 33 Feet. So, Stay worry-free during water sports and outdoor trips, and fully embrace the joy of movement.
